Hi Priya / Samir —

Great to speak with you today. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary use case: reduced latency for fraud scoring and conversational customer support during peak hours.
- Volume: ~120M tokens/month projected after Q3; steady growth.
- Decision criteria: predictable latency, cost per token, and clear data handling/security controls.

Stakeholders you mentioned
- Economic buyer: Jake Murphy (CFO) — will sign PO/contract.
- Procurement lead: Elena Torres — owns onboarding and vendor checklist.
- Security: security@aurorapay.com (will handle questionnaire).

Action items / ask from Aurora
1) Can you confirm the procurement onboarding steps (vendor portal, PO template, required evidence) and an expected timeline for PO issuance?
2) Please share the procurement contact (Elena) and the billing contact for invoicing.
3) We attached our vendor onboarding form for your team to review. If you have an Aurora PO template, please send that back so we can align.

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (blank onboarding form / required fields)

Proposed Redwood next steps
- Marissa + Rishi to draft a short mutual action plan (MAP) once we have the procurement checklist.
- If useful, we can schedule a 30-min sync with Elena + Jake to accelerate PO and SLA discussions.

Suggested times (PST): Wed 3/10 10:00-11:00 or Thu 3/11 9:00-10:00 — let me know what works.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,

Thanks for the recap, Marissa — great call. Quick answers below and I copied Elena separately.

Procurement / onboarding steps (high level)
- We require: completed vendor onboarding form, W-9, and security questionnaire (for vendors with access to customer data).
- Vendor portal: we use a self-service portal for new vendors; Elena will send an invite after the onboarding form is reviewed.
- PO cadence: Aurora issues POs via our portal; standard terms are Net-30.
- Timeline: typical vendor onboarding is 2–4 weeks once we have completed docs and SLAs reviewed.

Contacts
- Procurement lead: Elena Torres <elena.torres@aurorapay.com> (copied).
- Billing contact: accounts-payable@aurorapay.com (use Aurora PO number on invoices).
- Economic buyer: Jake Murphy (CFO) — jake.murphy@aurorapay.com.

Attachments: I’ve attached Aurora’s vendor onboarding checklist and a PO template we prefer (see attachment).

A few notes from security (copied text)
> For vendors handling PII or transactional data: we’ll need a completed security questionnaire. We typically run the questionnaire in parallel to procurement and will escalate any high-risk findings.

Next steps
- I’ll review your Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx and upload to the portal. Elena will send the portal invite once the form is accepted.
- Happy to schedule a short procurement+security sync with Elena and our security lead if that helps.

Regards,
Priya Desai
Head of Product Operations
Aurora Payments

Hi all — quick technical/ops notes to help the procurement/security conversation: 

- Technical onboarding: we support SAML SSO for admin access and can provide a scoped service account for API access. Will need an IP allowlist if you plan on restricting connections.
- Data handling: logs and content are retained per contract; default retention is 90 days but we can negotiate a longer or shorter term depending on compliance needs.
- Evidence: our security pack includes SOC 2 Type II summary, data flow diagram, and encryption-at-rest docs. I’ll attach links in the MAP.

If procurement prefers, we can share a short doc that maps required procurement evidence to the files we provide — should save review time.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
